column40: Game 1 of the inaugural 1983-84 Basketball Festival (Nonggu Daejanchi) Finals.
Samsung Electronics leveled the 1983-84 Basketball Festival Finals series 1-1.
Hyundai Electronics won the deciding Game 3 to claim the inaugural Basketball Festival title (2-1).
